title: Protocol for the assessment of human T cell activation by real-time metabolic flux analysis
protocol: Start sensor hydration and instrument warm up the day before the experiment.
Take out the ‘Sensor Cartridge (green) & Utility plate (pink)’ from Seahorse XFe24 Fluxpaks in the clean bench.
Add autoclaved ddH2O 1 mL/well in Utility plate.
Place the Sensor Cartridge over the Utility plate and incubate this in a non-CO2 incubator at 37°C for 24 hours.
Pour 25 mL of XF Calibrant (pH 7.4) into a conical tube and incubate it in a non-CO2 incubator at 37°C for 24 hours.
Turn on the XFe24 analyzer a minimum of 4 hours before starting the experiment.
1 hour before starting the experiment, remove both XF Calibrant and Sensor Cartridge & Utility plate from the incubator.
Remove all ddH2O in Utility plate.
Add XF Calibrant 1 mL/well to Utility plate.
Incubate the Sensor Cartridge & Utility plate with XF Calibrant in a non-CO2 incubator.
Adjust pH level of pre-warmed XF RPMI media with L-glutamine to pH level of 7.4 using NaOH 0.1 N, adding approximately 80–100 μL of NaOH 0.1N for 40 mL XF RPMI medium.
Keep the medium warm at 37°C in a water bath.
Seed cells in XF cell culture microplate.
Coat the XF cell culture microplate wells with either coating solution before seeding cells.
Use poly-d-lysine or Cell TakTM as an alternative coating agent if needed.
Dispense 50 μL of poly-d-lysine (50 μg/mL in DPBS) into each well for a 1-hour incubation at room temperature.
Alternatively, prepare Cell TakTM by dissolving 5.74 μL in 0.5 mL of 0.1 M sodium carbonate solution and incubate the solution for 15-20 minutes at room temperature before use.
Tilt and stir the plate to ensure even distribution of the coating solution across each well.
Store coated XF cell culture microplate in a refrigerator at 4°C for up to one week if not used immediately.
Coat all wells with either poly-d-lysine or Cell TakTM.
Do not seed cells on A1, B4, C3, D6 wells for blank/background correction.
Aspirate off the coating media from all wells.
Wash the wells with autoclaved ddH2O twice.
Let the wells air dry completely.
Adjust T cell concentrations to 1.0 × 10^6 cells/mL in XF running media containing L-glutamine.
Seed samples in duplicates or triplicates as needed.
Add 100 μL of cells into each well, equivalent to 1 × 10^5 cells/well for XFe24 analysis.
Centrifuge the plate for 5 minutes at 400 g.
Add 450 μL of XF media slowly to each well without disrupting the monolayer.
Observe cells under a microscope to ensure all groups have a stable monolayer.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a non-CO2 incubator for 30-60 minutes.
Dilute compound MOTS-c to an 8× concentration using XF running medium.
Load 75 μL of the 8× diluted MOTS-c into Drug Port A of the sensor cartridge.
Prepare αCD3 at a concentration of 4 μg/mL in solution.
Prepare αCD28 at a concentration of 20 μg/mL in solution.
Mix prepared αCD3 and αCD28 solutions together.
Load mixed αCD3 and αCD28 solution into Drug Port B of the sensor cartridge.
Incubate Sensor Cartridge + Utility plate with drugs loaded in ports for 15–25 minutes in a non-Co2 incubator.
Set up Seahorse program (XFe24) for real-time human T cell activation.
Equilibrate for 12 minutes.
Measure basal conditions for 2-3 minutes mixture and then 5 minutes measurement, repeated three times.
Wait 2-3 minutes after the first injection of drug of interest.
Measure 5 minutes after each injection of the drug of interest, repeated seven times.
Wait 2-3 minutes after the second injection of αCD3&αCD28.
Measure 5 minutes after each injection of αCD3&αCD28, repeated fourteen times.
